content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Raleigh

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher, you're ready to start. This makes CAPM ideal for Raleigh professionals entering project management roles across technology, healthcare, finance, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy delivers this requirement through live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp training designed for working professionals. Our intensive format compresses the coursework into a manageable schedule, so you earn your contact hours without lengthy commitments. Classes run nationwide and sync with your availability.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing education hours, you'll apply directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through this process step-by-step, ensuring your application meets all requirements. Once approved, you're cleared to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and coaching to reinforce CAPM knowledge domains. You'll sit for the proctored exam on your schedule, testing your readiness to lead and support project work in Raleigh's dynamic industries.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification renews on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units through training, volunteering, or work experience to satisfy renewal requirements. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses to keep your credential active and your skills current.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth pursuing for Raleigh project management careers?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Raleigh's Research Triangle employers—spanning technology, biotech, healthcare, finance, and state government—increasingly prefer or require formal project management credentials for mid-level roles. CAPM demonstrates foundational competency recognized across these sectors and often leads to faster career advancement and competitive compensation premiums compared to non-certified peers in the local market.

fq_items.question: Which Raleigh industries most value CAPM and PMP certification?
fq_items.answer: Technology and software firms in Research Triangle Park, biotech and pharmaceutical companies, banking and financial services, state and local government agencies, healthcare systems, and higher education institutions all actively seek certified project managers. Government and healthcare roles particularly emphasize formal credentials as differentiators for advancement and specialized project work.

fq_items.question: Can I attend Granite PM Academy's CAPM live-virtual training from my Raleigh workplace?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our live-virtual CAPM training is delivered 100% online, so you can attend from your office, home, or any location with internet access. Many Raleigh professionals complete certification while maintaining their current role, coordinating class schedules with employer support or flexible work arrangements.

fq_items.question: When should Raleigh professionals pursue CAPM certification to stay competitive?
fq_items.answer: Raleigh's competitive job market rewards early credential investment. If you're in an entry-level or junior project role at a Research Triangle employer or planning to transition into project management, pursuing CAPM soon strengthens your candidacy and demonstrates commitment to the discipline before advancing to senior positions where PMP often becomes expected.
